metadata.question: Does surface water extent in Death Valley National Park increase in August 7, 2022 compared to July 11, 2022?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing surface water extent in Death Valley National Park between two specific dates: August 7, 2022 and July 11, 2022. For surface water detection, I'll use: 1. Sentinel-2 imagery (good resolution for water detection) 2. NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to identify water pixels 3. Cloud masking to ensure clean analysis Steps: 1. Define Death Valley National Park geometry (I'll use a rough bounding box) 2. Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates 3. Calculate NDWI for both images 4. Apply a threshold (typically >0.0) to identify water pixels 5. Count water pixels for each date 6. Compare the counts I need to handle: - Checking if images exist for both dates - Checking if valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Validating the results For water detection, I'll use: NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) Where Green = B3, NIR = B8 for Sentinel-2 Threshold: NDWI > 0.0 typically indicates water ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const deathValley = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-117.2, 36.8], [-116.2, 36.8], [-116.2, 36.2], [-117.2, 36.2] ]); const date1 = '2022-07-11'; const date2 = '2022-08-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition const getWaterImage = function(targetDate) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(deathValley) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-1, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); return collection.median() .clip(deathValley); }; const img1 = getWaterImage(date1); const img2 = getWaterImage(date2); // Check if collections are empty const checkCollection = function(targetDate) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(deathValley) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-1, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')); return col.size(); }; const count1 = checkCollection(date1).getInfo(); const count2 = checkCollection(date2).getInfo(); print(`${date1} Images: ${count1}`); print(`${date2} Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 3. Water Detection Processing const calculateWaterArea = function(img) { // Calculate NDWI const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Apply water threshold (NDWI > 0.0) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0); // Count water pixels const stats = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: deathValley, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.get('NDWI'); }; const water1 = calculateWaterArea(img1).getInfo(); const water2 = calculateWaterArea(img2).getInfo(); print(`July 11 Water Pixels: ${water1}`); print(`August 7 Water Pixels: ${water2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (water1 === null || water2 === null || isNaN(water1) || isNaN(water2) || water1 < 0 || water2 < 0) { print("C3"); } else if (water1 === 0 || water2 === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (water2 > water1) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
